correctness.rationale: Every nonhorizontal shadow reduces to the convex hull of two directly homothetic polygons; interior center gives n vertices, exterior center gives n+2 by two tangent rays and the complementary boundary chains. Planar Cauchy density for the homothety center yields the exact solid-angle law. Strict derivative and regular-polygon triangle-angle integration are explicit. The bundled numerical checker passed 20 quadratures, 2250 irregular convex hull tests, and 21000 random orientations; these are corroboration only.

originality.rationale: The full polygonal silhouette vertex-count dichotomy and its Cauchy/solid-angle law were compared by implication with indexed research results and inspected primary literature. The crucial inner-copy containment condition is explicitly prior art (Horváth–Lángi 2022); independent content lies in exhaustive complementary vertex-count classification and integrated random-direction distribution. No covering statement was identified in inspected material, but historical priority remains provisional.
residual_risks: A similar planar hull combinatorics lemma may occur in older unindexed computational geometry or optics literature under a different terminology.
Only page one of the relevant 2016 random-polytope silhouette article was inspected; its abstract and object mismatch are clear but it was not certified not-covering in entirety.
Some historical source texts are not systematically available and no originality certification is claimed.
